question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT IS NULL THEN 'No item line' 
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 'One item line' 
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1 THEN 'Multi-line order' 
  END AS ORDER_TYPE,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.ORDER_ID) AS ORDER_COUNT,
  SUM(i.ITEM_QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_UNITS,
  AVG(i.ITEM_QUANTITY) AS AVG_UNITS_PER_ORDER
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_BASE o
LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_ITEM_ROLLUP i
  ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ORDER_TYPE
ORDER BY 
  CASE ORDER_TYPE 
    WHEN 'No item line' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'One item line' THEN 2 
    WHEN 'Multi-line order' THEN 3 
    ELSE 4 END
action.metrics: order count, total units, average units per order
action.group_by: order type (no item line, one item line, multi-line order)

action.metrics: Share of orders with more than one item line; average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; count of orders with no item line
action.group_by: Order type (one item line, multi-line order, no item line)
action.answer:
In 2025, there were no orders with zero item lines (no such rows were returned). Out of all orders:

- 1,307,684 orders (29.98%) had exactly one item line, with an average of 1.219753 units per order.
- 3,052,089 orders (70.02%) had more than one item line, with an average of 3.484769 units per order.
- 0 orders had no item line.

Interpretation: The majority of orders (70.02%) in 2025 were multi-line, and these orders had a much higher average number of units per order compared to single-line orders. No orders were found without any item lines in the data.
action.reason: All requested values are present in the query result. The share of multi-line orders is calculated as 3,052,089 / (1,307,684 + 3,052,089) = 70.02%. No orders with zero item lines were found.
